verdict.rationale: Zep documents an official Python SDK, installed with `pip install zep-cloud`. The quick start says you can add memory in three lines of code, and the docs show concrete client methods such as `client.graph.edge.delete` and `thread.add_messages(return_context=True)`. missing for 10: evidence of SDKs beyond Python (e.g. TypeScript/Go), an SDK reference or versioning documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Add agent memory to your app in three lines of code.
you can pass in the return_context=True flag to the thread.add_messages() method.
